about: Each kernel self-test section's kernel/src files (tools/section-select.mts). Seeded in S113 (kickoffs/s113 ruling 15) from each section's static and dynamic imports of kernel/src and the verbs it runs through the CLI (the modules cli.ts calls for each verb); a file no section reached that way is claimed by the sections that claim a file importing it. A new kernel/src file needs a claim here, or the commit tier refuses it.
